Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rajesh Kumar
For the Petitioner : Mr. R. N. Prasad, Advocate
For the State : Mr. Tapas Roy, A.P.P
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned counsel for the State.

2. The applicant, who is in custody since 29.10.2022, has approached this Court for grant of regular bail in connection with Katkamsandi (Pelawal O.P.) P.S. Case No.12 of 2015, corresponding to G.R.
No.194 of 2015, registered for the offence under Sections 120B/ 420/ 467/ 468/ 387 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. It appears that the applicant has been made an accused for selling the land of the informant by impersonating himself as owner.

4. It has been submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that complete set of F.I.R along with its enclosures have been annexed with the present bail application and there is no suppression on his part.
Innocence of the applicant has been claimed and undertaking has been given for participation in the trial.
It has been submitted that the applicant is one of the co-sharer and he is entitled to sale out the property.

5. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for bail.
6. Considering the above fact, I am inclined to enlarge the applicant on bail.

Accordingly, the applicant is directed to be released on bail, on his furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Hazaribag in connection with Katkamsandi (Pelawal O.P.) P.S. Case No.12 of 2015, corresponding to G.R. No.194 of 2015, on the condition that the applicant will submit self-attested photocopy of his Aadhaar Card and also submit his mobile number before the learned court below which he will always keep active and will not change it during pendency of this case without prior permission of the court.

(Rajesh Kumar, J.) Chandan/-
